name: Backward Walking

instructions.description: Stand tall in a clear open space and look occasionally over your shoulder to check the path.
Take small steps backward by reaching one foot behind you and rolling onto it carefully.
Keep the trunk upright and the knees softly bent as you continue moving.
Stop safely, turn, and walk forward to reset.

performanceMetrics.notes: Measure only on a safe obstacle-free path.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: March backward more slowly with support nearby.

commentsNotes: Ensure the area behind you is clear before every repetition.
Use very small steps at first.
